children: Colombia's budget for next year shows a deep imbalance and requires major adjustments to stabilize debt, Fitch Ratings said on Wednesday.

The ratings agency noted that securing the level of financing proposed by the government in bond markets would be difficult and likely require substantial support from international financial institutions.
Failure to implement fiscal consolidation measures could further pressure Colombia's credit rating, Fitch added.
